1.t: Alif-Lãm-Ra. These are the verses of the Book; the clear Quran
1.tr: Alif-Laaam-Raa; tilka Aayaatul Kitaabi Wa-Qur-aa-nim Mubeen

2.t: ˹The day will come when˺ the disbelievers will certainly wish they had submitted ˹to Allah˺
2.tr: Rubamaa yawaddul lazeena kafaroo law kaanoo muslimeen

3.t: ˹So˺ let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by ˹false˺ hope, for they will soon know
3.tr: Zarhum yaakuloo Wa-yatamatta'oo Wa-yulhihimul amalu fasawfa ya'lamoon

4.t: We have never destroyed a society without a destined term
4.tr: Wa-maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa Wa-lahaa kitaabum ma'loom

5.t: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it
5.tr: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa Wa-maa yastaakhiroon

6.t: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder is revealed! You must be insane
6.tr: Wa-qaaloo yaaa-aiyuhal lazee nuzzila 'alaihiz Zikru innaka lamajnoon

7.t: Why do you not bring us the angels, if what you say is true?”
7.tr: Law maa taateenaa bil-malaaa'ikati in kunta minas saadiqeen

8.t: We do not send the angels down except for a just cause, and then ˹the end of˺ the disbelievers will not be delayed
8.tr: Maa nunazzilul malaaa'i-kata illaa bilhaqqi Wa-maa kaanooo izam munzareen

9.t: It is certainly We Who have revealed the Reminder, and it is certainly We Who will preserve it
9.tr: Innaa Nahnu nazalnaz Zikra Wa-Innaa lahoo lahaa-fizoon

10.t: Indeed, We sent messengers before you ˹O Prophet˺ among the groups of early peoples
10.tr: Wa-laqad arsalnaa min qablika fee shiya'il awwaleen

11.t: but no messenger ever came to them without being mocked
11.tr: Wa-maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

12.t: This is how We allow disbelief ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked

13.t: They would not believe in this ˹Quran˺ despite the ˹many˺ examples of those ˹destroyed˺ before
13.tr: Laa yu'minoona bihee Wa-qad khalat sunnatul awwaleen

14.t: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend
14.tr: Wa-law fatahnaa 'alaihim baabam minas samaaa'i fazaloo feehi ya'rujoon

15.t: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”
15.tr: Laqaaloo innamaa sukkirat absaarunaa bal nahnu qawmum mashooroon

16.t: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see
16.tr: Wa-laqad ja'alnaa fis samaaa'i buroojanw Wa-zaiyannaahaa linnaazireen

17.t: And We protected it from every accursed devil

18.t: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare
18.tr: Illaa manis taraqas sam'a fa-atba'ahoo shihaabum mubeen

19.t: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused everything to grow there in perfect balance
19.tr: Wal-arda madadnaahaa Wa-alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya Wa-ambatnaa feehaa min kulli shai'im mawzoon

20.t: And We made in it means of sustenance for you and others, who you do not provide for
20.tr: Wa-ja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayisha Wa-mal lastum lahoo biraaziqeen

21.t: There is not any means ˹of sustenance˺ whose reserves We do not hold, only bringing it forth in precise measure
21.tr: Wa-im min shai'in illaa 'indanaa khazaaa-'inuhoo Wa-maa nunazziluhooo illaa biqadarim ma'loom

22.t: We send fertilizing winds, and bring down rain from the sky for you to drink. It is not you who hold its reserves
22.tr: Wa-arsalnar riyaaha la-waaqiha fa-anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa-asqai-naakumoohu Wa-maaa antum lahoo bikhaazineen

23.t: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death. And We are the ˹Eternal˺ Successor
23.tr: Wa-innnaa la-nahnu nuhyee Wa-numeetu Wa-nahnul waarisoon

24.t: We certainly know those who have gone before you and those who will come after ˹you˺

25.t: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ will gather them together ˹for judgment˺. He is truly All-Wise, All-Knowing
25.tr: Wa-inna Rabbaka Huwa yahshuruhum; innahoo Hakeemun 'Aleem

26.t: Indeed, We created man from sounding clay moulded from black mud
26.tr: Wa-laqad khalaqnal insaana min salsaalim min hama-im masnoon

27.t: As for the jinn, We created them earlier from smokeless fire
27.tr: Waljaaanna khalaqnaahu min qablu min naaris samoom

28.t: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay moulded from black mud
28.tr: Wa-iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa'-ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min salsaalim min hama-im masnoon

29.t: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”
29.tr: Fa-izaa sawwaituhoo Wa-nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen

30.t: So the angels prostrated all together—

31.t: but not Iblîs, who refused to prostrate with the others
31.tr: Illaaa ibleesa abaaa ai yakoona ma'as saajideen

32.t: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What is the matter with you that you did not join others in prostration?”
32.tr: Qaala yaaa-Ibleesu maa laka allaa takoona ma'as saajideen

33.t: He replied, “It is not for me to prostrate to a human You created from sounding clay moulded from black mud.”
33.tr: Qaala lam akul li-asjuda libasharin khalaqtahoo min salsaalim min hama-im masnoon

34.t: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed

35.t: And surely upon you is condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

36.t: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”
36.tr: Qaala Rabbi fa-anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

39.t: Satan responded, “My Lord! For allowing me to stray I will surely tempt them on earth and mislead them all together
39.tr: Qaala Rabbi bimaaa aghwaitanee la-uzayyin-anna lahum fil ardi Wa-la-ughwiyan-nahum ajma'een

40.t: except Your chosen servants among them.”

41.t: Allah said, “This is the Way, binding on Me

42.t: you will certainly have no authority over My servants, except the deviant who follow you
42.tr: Inna 'ibaadee laisa laka 'alaihim sultaanun illaa manit taba'aka minal ghaaween

43.t: and surely Hell is their destined place, all together

44.t: It has seven gates, to each a group of them is designated.”
44.tr: Lahaa sab'atu abwaab; likulli baabim minhum juz'um maqsoom

45.t: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs

46.t: ˹It will be said to them,˺ “Enter in peace and security.”

47.t: We will remove whatever bitterness they had in their hearts. In a friendly manner, they will be on thrones, facing one another
47.tr: Wa-naza'naa ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwaanan 'alaa sururim mutaqaabileen

48.t: No fatigue will touch them there, nor will they ever be asked to leave
48.tr: Laa yamas-suhum feehaa nasabunw Wa-maa hum minhaa bimukhrajeen

49.t: Inform My servants ˹O Prophet˺ that I am truly the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

50.t: and that My torment is indeed the most painful

51.t: And inform them ˹O Prophet˺ about Abraham’s guests

52.t: who entered upon him and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He ˹later˺ said, “Surely we are afraid of you.”
52.tr: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala innaa minkum wajiloon

53.t: They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! Surely we give you good news of a knowledgeable son.”
53.tr: Qaaloo la tawjal innaa nubashshiruka bighulaamin 'aleem

54.t: He wondered, “Do you give me good news despite my old age? What unlikely news!”
54.tr: Qaala abashshartumoonee 'alaaa am massaniyal kibaru fabima tubashshiroon

55.t: They responded, “We give you good news in all truth, so do not be one of those who despair.”
55.tr: Qaaloo bashsharnaaka bilhaqqi falaa takum minal qaaniteen

56.t: He exclaimed, “Who would despair of the mercy of their Lord except the misguided?”
56.tr: Qaala Wa-mai yaqnatu mir rahmati Rabbiheee illad daaaloon

57.t: He ˹then˺ added, “What is your mission, O messenger-angels?”

58.t: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people
58.tr: Qaaloo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

59.t: As for the family of Lot, we will certainly deliver them all
59.tr: Illaaa Aala Loot; innaa lamunajjoohum ajma'een

60.t: except his wife. We have determined that she will be one of the doomed.”
60.tr: Illam ra-atahoo qaddarnaaa innahaa laminal ghaabireen

61.t: So when the messengers came to the family of Lot

62.t: he said, “You are surely an unfamiliar people!”

63.t: They responded, “We have come to you with that ˹torment˺ which they have doubted
63.tr: Qaaloo bal ji'naaka bimaa kaanoo feehi yamtaroon

64.t: We come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful

65.t: So travel with your family in the dark of night, and follow ˹closely˺ behind them. Do not let any of you look back, and go where you are commanded.”
65.tr: Fa-asri bi-ahlika biqit'im minal laili wattabi' adbaarahum Wa-laa yaltafit minkum ahadunw wamdoo haisu tu'maroon

66.t: We revealed to him this decree: “Those ˹sinners˺ will be uprooted in the morning.”
66.tr: Wa-qadainaaa ilaihi zaalikal amra anna daabira haaa'ulaaa'i maqtoo'um musbiheen

67.t: And there came the men of the city, rejoicing

68.t: Lot pleaded, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me
68.tr: Qaala inna haaa'ulaaa'i daifee falaa tafdahoon

69.t: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.”

70.t: They responded, “Have we not forbidden you from protecting anyone?”

71.t: He said, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹so marry them˺ if you wish to do so.”
71.tr: Qaala haaa'ulaaa'i banaateee in kuntum faa'ileen

72.t: By your life ˹O Prophet˺, they certainly wandered blindly, intoxicated ˹by lust˺

73.t: So the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them at sunrise

74.t: And We turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay
74.tr: Faja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa Wa-amtamaa 'alaihim hijaaratam min sijjeel

75.t: Surely in this are signs for those who contemplate

76.t: Their ruins still lie along a known route

77.t: Surely in this is a sign for those who believe

78.t: And the residents of the Forest were truly wrongdoers

79.t: so We inflicted punishment upon them. The ruins of both nations still lie on a well-known road

80.t: Indeed, the residents of the Stone Valley also denied the messengers

81.t: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them

82.t: They carved their homes in the mountains, feeling secure
82.tr: Wa-kaanoo yanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan aamineen

83.t: But the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them in the morning

84.t: and all they achieved was of no help to them

85.t: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything in between except for a purpose. And the Hour is certain to come, so forgive graciously
85.tr: Wa-maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal-arda Wa-maa bainahumaaa illaa bilhaqq; Wa-innas Saa'ata la-aatiyatun fasfahis safhal jameel

86.t: Surely your Lord is the Master Creator, All-Knowing

87.t: We have certainly granted you the seven often-repeated verses and the great Quran
87.tr: Wa-laqad aatainaaka sab'am minal masaanee wal-Qur-aanal 'Azeem

88.t: Do not let your eyes crave the ˹fleeting˺ pleasures We have provided for some of the disbelievers, nor grieve for them. And be gracious to the believers
88.tr: Laa tamuddanna 'ainaika ilaa maa matta-'naa biheee azwaajam minhum Wa-laa tahzan 'alaihim wakhfid janaahaka lilmu-'mineen

89.t: And say, “I am truly sent with a clear warning”—

90.t: ˹a warning˺ similar to what We sent to those who divided ˹the Scriptures˺

91.t: who ˹now˺ accept parts of the Quran, rejecting others

92.t: So by your Lord! We will certainly question them all

93.t: about what they used to do

94.t: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists
94.tr: Fasda' bimaa tu'maru Wa-a'rid anil mushrikeen

95.t: Surely We will be sufficient for you against the mockers

96.t: who set up ˹other˺ gods with Allah. They will soon come to know
96.tr: Allazeena yaj'aloona ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhar; fasawfa ya'lamoon

97.t: We certainly know that your heart is truly distressed by what they say
97.tr: Wa-laqad na'lamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon

98.t: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be one of those who ˹always˺ pray
98.tr: Fasbbih bihamdi Rabbika Wa-kum minas saajideen

99.t: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes your way
